modes.title: Panel press is an impact tap, never verified -> QUICK silently not started
modes.mechanism: The scripted press stops when the unfiltered wrist F/T reads 3 N, resets its reference to the measured pose and "holds" 0.3 s; the pad actually sees > 1 N for only 12 ms (nominal registration needs 8 ms) and ~0.07 N during the hold. Any pad needing >= 1.4 N (or a longer debounce) never registers; the Runner checks only the touch-sensor peak (>1 N), never the panel display.
also_seen: min runs: cart yaw 0.5 deg / appliance yaw 1.25 deg -> POWER press not registered
modes.threshold: fails at pad threshold 1.375 N (nominal 1.0 N passes); GPT proposed 4.0 N
modes.sim_caveat: the 12 ms impact transient depends on the sim contact stiffness (solref 6 ms); the margin, not the weakness, is sim-specific
modes.novelty: new mechanism (same symptom as known button_miss)
modes.real_robot_detects: no - Runner claims success; only the panel display/beep would show it
modes.fix: Hold a regulated force (admittance, e.g. 3-5 N for >= 0.3 s) instead of stop-on-threshold; verify the panel display after each press and retry; calibrate per appliance the force/duration that registers. (The GPT-L1 press skill already holds ~3 N for 0.5 s.)

modes.title: Pod rotated in its dish -> pod bridges the groove or later falls to the tub floor
modes.mechanism: The pod pick uses the taught dish pose and a fixed 0 deg grasp yaw. A tablet lying >= ~34 deg rotated is pinched across a diagonal, is carried skewed and lands on the groove rim instead of in it (detected only by the ground-truth pod check). At 28 deg it seats loosely and is shaken out later (found on the tub floor) while the Runner claims success.
also_seen: S_16, S_17 (yaw 27-33 deg combined with a pod/dish offset -> pod not lifted)
modes.threshold: 34 deg -> not seated (detected by GT check); 28 deg -> silent (pod on tub floor at the end); 22.5 deg -> success
modes.sim_caveat: rigid box pod and groove; real tablets are slightly compliant
modes.novelty: new (known pod_moved = pod not in its dish)
modes.real_robot_detects: no - pod-in-groove is not sensed; a real robot would report success
modes.fix: Perceive the pod (camera + VLM) and grasp along its measured yaw even when it is in the dish; verify pod-in-groove (camera view of the door, or in-hand pose check before release).

modes.title: Target slot already occupied -> carried plate strikes it, 200-320 N robot-plate contact, plate knocked out
modes.mechanism: No slot-occupancy check and a carry height computed for an empty basket: the carried plate hits the plate already standing in slot 6 during carry_across/descent, is wrenched in the fingers (204-317 N between hand/link7 and the plate) and ends lying on the basket front / open door.
modes.threshold: one plate in the target slot (structural, no magnitude)
modes.sim_caveat: pre-loaded plates are rigid with the basket (no wobble), so contact forces are overestimated
modes.real_robot_detects: partly - large wrist forces would be measurable, but the Runner has no such guard; seating check is ground truth only
modes.fix: Perceive basket occupancy (camera over the pulled-out basket) and choose a free slot; force guard on the carry (abort above ~20 N unexpected load); compute the carry height from the perceived contents.

modes.title: Clutter in the arm sweep knocked off the counter, Runner unaware
modes.mechanism: The motion collision model is the calibrated empty kitchen. A bottle standing 35 mm from the counter edge next to the plate is hit by link 6 during the edge-push approach (12 N) and falls to the floor; the mission still completes and the Runner claims success.
modes.threshold: structural (object inside the swept volume); not bisected
modes.sim_caveat: bottle = rigid cylinder; a real FR3 collision reflex would not trigger at 12 N
modes.real_robot_detects: no - the contact is far below any collision threshold; nothing in the Runner looks at the counter after perception
modes.fix: Obstacle perception (depth occupancy of the counter) fed into the motion planner / swept-volume check; refuse or ask the user to clear the area.

modes.title: Small rotation of cart or appliance -> pod pick / placement misses (bar grasp still succeeds)
modes.mechanism: The compliant bar grasp tolerates a small yaw, but the pod pick (taught dish spot, 0.6 m from the arm base) and the groove placement do not: 1 deg of cart yaw moves the dish ~10 mm in the arm frame -> pod not lifted; 1.9 deg of appliance yaw moves the groove ~6-8 mm -> pod lands on the groove rim.
modes.threshold: cart yaw 1.0 deg (0.5 deg -> silent QUICK failure instead, see M1); appliance yaw 1.875 deg (1.25 deg -> silent QUICK failure)
modes.real_robot_detects: pod not lifted: yes (finger width); pod off the groove: no
modes.fix: Re-localise the cart and the appliance at the start of every run (fiducials on the appliance / dock, or a door-bar touch-off) and correct all taught poses.

modes.title: Appliance nudged ~1 cm or cart docked ~1-2 cm off -> pull-bar grasp misses
modes.mechanism: All appliance poses are calibrated once. Pushing the dishwasher back by 11 mm (or a lateral cart error of ~1.4 cm) puts the 8 mm-radius pull bar outside the grasp; the fingers close on air (detected). At 7.5 mm the door still opens but the QUICK/POWER pads (24 x 16 mm) are missed.
modes.threshold: dishwasher pushed back 11 mm (7.5 mm -> button pads missed instead); cart lateral 14 mm (S_11)
modes.real_robot_detects: yes - finger encoders read 0 mm (closed on nothing)
modes.fix: Same as M5: per-run re-localisation; plus a guarded search around the expected bar pose before giving up.

modes.title: Sticky basket rail (>= ~5 N) -> light bar squeeze slips, basket not pulled out
modes.mechanism: The basket bar is held with a 5 N squeeze on a 4 mm wire and pulled on a position-controlled path. Rail friction of ~5 N stops the basket at 0.237 m; >= 7 N the fingers slide off immediately and the basket stays in.
modes.threshold: 4.9 N -> stops at 0.237 m; 7.2 N -> not moved (nominal 0.3 N)
modes.sim_caveat: slip threshold depends on modelled finger-pad friction (mu 0.6) and the round-wire contact
modes.real_robot_detects: yes - basket position from the appliance sensor / hand position
modes.fix: Grip the bar firmly (form closure around the wire, higher squeeze) and pull with force control and a stall detector; retry with a push-pull wiggle.

modes.title: Stiff / damped door hinge -> bar slips, door does not open
modes.mechanism: Same light 5 N squeeze on the round door bar with a position-controlled 8 s arc: hinge friction ~2 N m with 5 N m s/rad damping (or 2.6 N m) exceeds what the fingers can transmit; the door stays at 0-2 deg.
modes.threshold: fails at 2.0 N m + 4.9 N m s/rad (door at 2 deg); passes at 1.43 N m + 3.7; GPT tested 2.0 N m with nominal damping -> passed
modes.sim_caveat: as M7 (finger friction model); real doors also have a latch needing 20-50 N, not modelled
modes.novelty: new (known door_latch = door springs back after opening)
modes.fix: Firmer grasp (hook the bar), force-controlled opening along the hinge arc with a measured-force budget; detect slip from the hand-door relative motion.

modes.title: Plate is not an 8-inch plate -> refused by the radius gate (9" and up, 7.4" and down); 8.6" accepted but over-squeezed
modes.mechanism: Perception gates the fitted radius at 95-110 mm and every manipulation constant assumes 101.5 mm. A standard 9" plate (114 mm) is refused at step 1 (safe stop). An 8.6" plate (109 mm) passes the gate; the rim pinch geometry is off and the palm presses the rim with 71 N during the tilt (mission still succeeds).
also_seen: G_r6_s2 (109 mm: degraded, 71 N palm-rim contact)
modes.threshold: deterministic gate: r > 110 mm or < 95 mm
modes.real_robot_detects: yes - refuses safely; the 8.6" case is not noticed
modes.fix: Parameterise the edge-push, pinch and slot geometry by the measured radius (or a small set of plate classes) and validate per class; keep the gate as a hard limit for sizes the basket cannot take.

modes.title: Pod not at the taught spot (dish moved ~2.5 cm, or pod 16 mm off-centre) -> pod not lifted
modes.mechanism: The pod is picked blind at the taught dish position. A dish displaced by 2.5 cm (or a pod off-centre in the dish) leaves the fingers closing beside it.
modes.fix: Always locate the pod with the camera before picking (the GPT-L1 stack already does this when it notices).

modes.title: Plate lying face-down -> edge push rides over the inverted rim, under-travel
modes.mechanism: The push finger is placed for the face-up rim profile; on an inverted plate it presses on the (now upward) foot side and slides over: 12 mm overhang instead of 45 mm, the pinch is impossible (detected by the overhang check, which uses ground truth).
also_seen: R_03 (face-down, but its stop was caused by the cart offset)
modes.sim_caveat: plate rim modelled by 36 flat segments; the exact slide-over depends on that profile
modes.real_robot_detects: partly - re-perception at the edge would show the small overhang
modes.fix: Detect plate orientation (depth profile: concave vs convex) and either flip it or use a face-down push/pinch recipe; check the overhang with the re-perception before pinching.

modes.title: Wall camera knocked (~2 deg pitch + 2 cm) -> plate pose error, push under-travel; smaller bumps over-squeeze the rim
modes.mechanism: The camera extrinsics are never re-checked. A 2 deg pitch + 20 mm shift gives a 4.4 mm centre and 2 deg normal error; the open-loop drag stops 25 mm short (20 mm overhang). Smaller bumps (1-2 deg) still complete but with 47-71 N palm-rim contact.
modes.threshold: 1.5 deg + 15 mm passes; 2 deg + 20 mm fails
modes.sim_caveat: S_22 (insertion off-centre with a bump) did not reproduce with seed 2
modes.real_robot_detects: partly (overhang check uses GT in the sim; a real robot would need the re-perception)
modes.fix: Self-check the extrinsics every run against fixed fiducials (or the counter edge / appliance outline) and refuse when off; close the push loop on the re-perceived overhang.

known.title: person near the robot, Runner ignores the flag (known fault "person")
pod on the counter, not in its dish (known fault "pod_moved")

notes: R_15: perception mis-fit (radius 155 mm) with camera yaw -2.65 deg, dishwasher shifted 4.6 cm and 17 other changes; not minimised, left unattributed.
S_22 (camera bump + stiff pad + sensor noise -> insertion 12.6 mm off the slot): did not reproduce with seed 2; listed under M12 with that caveat.

Seating predicate: nominal seated lean is 7.5-9.5 deg against the 10 deg in_slot predicate, so tiny perturbations gave "not seated" at 10.3-11 deg. Treated as a predicate artefact: this study counts a plate as seated below 15 deg (the "seated" column of GPT_CONTROL.md) and keeps the 10 deg verdict in the run files.
